prompt.main_subject: An adult Asian woman with long dark hair sits at a high-rise marble bay-window ledge in an oversized buttoned white shirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Subjective 35mm-equivalent POV close portrait; one raised hand playfully blocks the lens, then lowers as the woman leans forward slightly. City skyline remains visible through tall glass.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural morning window light with soft sun and mild haze, white cotton, sky blue, concrete gray, warm skin tones, subtle grain, and natural vignetting.

technical_specs.camera: Subjective 35mm-equivalent POV, close portrait, subtle film grain and natural vignetting.
technical_specs.motion: Gentle lens block, hand lowering, slight lean forward, and calm direct gaze.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic photography style. An adult Asian woman sits in front of a high-rise bay window on a marble ledge, wearing an oversized buttoned white shirt with shoulders covered. From a subjective POV, she raises one hand to gently block the lens with a faint smile, then lowers it and leans forward slightly until her face fills more of the frame. She looks into the lens and says in a calm, playful tone, "You are always noticing the little details." Use natural daylight, delicate realistic detail, subtle film grain, and natural vignetting. Soften city noise behind the glass, leaving a quiet indoor atmosphere. Render no captions, logos, or watermark.
